title: Work item lease
description: Lease record that the core writes on every P1 claim: of a task attempt, a tool call or a delivery. The lease_no is 1 greater than the previous one of this work item; exactly one holder holds a work item (FEN-1). Every changing call of the holder carries the token, and a call with an outdated token, with a previous store or seat epoch gets fenced without writes (FEN-2). Lease lifecycle: spec/lifecycles/lease.md.

work_id.description: Work item id, common to all its leases; the external system gets the same id (FEN-7).

kind.description: Work kind; erasure is a step of an erasure or match request at an edge store (schema erasure-work).

lease_no.description: Lease number; it grows on every claim, including after outcomes that do not spend an attempt.

state.description: Lease state from spec/lifecycles/lease.md; preempted only for an attempt.

lease_until.description: Lease deadline by the store clock (TIM-1).

reason.description: Reason for the end of the lease from the reason registry.

run_id.description: Only an attempt: the runtime run id for E4 of the form <task id>:<lease_no>; one run per attempt lease.

owner.description: Only a personal assistant task: the initiating principal from the direct chat, whom the core writes into the lease at claim; the memory space and the session are chosen by it. The worker record has no such field (DSP-10).

acting_bot.description: The bot identity on whose behalf the attempt runs (IDN-8).

seat_epoch.description: Only seat tasks: the seat epoch; an attempt with an old epoch gets fenced (MGR-1).

token.description: Lease token (epoch, work_id, lease_no, worker_id). In the attempt token the core also writes acting_bot and bot_epoch, and for seat tasks seat_epoch. The holder passes the token in every changing P1 call (FEN-2) in the Botaru-Lease header as base64url without padding of the RFC 8785 form (spec/bindings/http/README.md); request bodies have no token field. The core accepts the call by matching the token against the active lease record and the worker_id against the worker from Authorization, otherwise lease_mismatch or fenced. The core may sign the token (key_id, sig are optional); then a wrong signature also gives lease_mismatch (spec/bindings/http/README.md, D-87 (5)).

key_id.description: Optional: id of the core key, if the core signs the token.

sig.description: Optional: the core's signature over the token without sig per spec/hashing.md, if the core signs the token; the holder does not parse the token.
